solves.reason: (A) 빈칸 — fullPassage: 'helps us adapt'. 선지 surrender vs adapt → adapt(적응하다) 맞음. (B) 빈칸 — fullPassage: 'acquire information from others'. discard vs acquire → acquire(획득하다) 맞음. (C) 빈칸 — fullPassage: 'accumulate pools of adaptive information'. deplete vs accumulate → accumulate(축적하다) 맞음. adapt-acquire-accumulate = ①.

(A) 빈칸 — fullPassage: 'more equitable and environmentally reasonable ways'. biased vs blank → equitable(공평한) 맞음. (B) 빈칸 — fullPassage: 'follow ecologically sound practices'. economically vs ecologically → ecologically(생태학적으로) 맞음. (C) 빈칸 — fullPassage: 'meaning supply for an elite demand'. universal vs elite → elite(상류층) 맞음. equitable-ecologically-elite = ③.

(A) 빈칸 — fullPassage: 'increased in parallel with increasing portion sizes'. contrast vs blank → parallel(나란히) 맞음. (B) 빈칸 — fullPassage: 'environment of portion distortion'. accuracy vs distortion → distortion(왜곡) 맞음. (C) 빈칸 — fullPassage: 'unintentionally consume more calories'. deliberately vs unintentionally → unintentionally(의도치 않게) 맞음. parallel-distortion-unintentionally = ①.
문맥상 부적절 (5지선다 — C5 위반이나 풀이 진행): ①difficulty, ②verbatim, ③comparison 적절. ④'rewarding' — fullPassage: 'copying everything is a wasteful endeavor'. wasteful(낭비적인)이 맞고 rewarding(보람 있는)은 반대. 부적절 = ④.
문맥상 부적절: ①similar 적절. ②'champion' — fullPassage: 'Race is an example of social construction'. construction(구성)이 맞고 champion(챔피언/옹호자)은 전혀 다른 의미. 부적절 = ②. ③evidence, ④barbarian 적절.
문맥상 부적절: ②monetary, ③marginalising, ④illegal 모두 적절. ①'ordinary' — fullPassage: 'meaning supply for an elite demand'. elite(상류층/특권층) 맞고 ordinary(일반적인/보통의)는 반대 의미. 부적절 = ①.
빈칸 어휘 완성 (5지선다 — C5 위반이나 풀이 진행): 'environment of portion ____' — fullPassage: 'distortion'. ④distortion — 원문 일치. ①control, ②reduction, ③balance는 불일치. 정답 ④.
빈칸 어휘 완성 (5지선다 — C5 위반이나 풀이 진행): 'we ____ information from others' — fullPassage: 'acquire'. ④acquire — 원문 일치. ①complex, ②species, ③copying는 불일치. 정답 ④.

빈칸 어휘 완성: 'reasoning in a hall of mirrors and ____ real social and environmental values' — fullPassage: 'marginalising'. ②marginalising — 원문 일치. ①ecologically, ③environmental, ④efficiencies는 불일치. 정답 ②.
동의어: 밑줄 'exceptionally' — 'We are exceptionally smart'. exceptionally = 매우/탁월하게. ①slightly(약간), ②ordinarily(보통), ④barely(거의 않게). ③remarkably(눈에 띄게/탁월하게) = 동의어. 정답 ③.
동의어: 밑줄 'endeavor' — 'copying everything is a wasteful endeavor'. endeavor = 노력/시도. ①effort(노력) = 동의어. ②reward(보상), ③obstacle(장애물), ④vacation(휴가)는 불일치. 정답 ①.
동의어: 밑줄 'conundrums' — 'escape the conundrums that production for trade entails'. conundrums = 난제/딜레마. ①regulations(규제), ③profits(이익), ④solutions(해결책). ②dilemmas(딜레마) = 동의어. 정답 ②.
반의어: 밑줄 'similar' — 'Most humans are genetically very similar'. similar = 유사한. 반의어 = distinct(구별되는/다른). ①equivalent(동등한), ②comparable(비교 가능한), ④alike(유사한)는 유의어. ③distinct — 반의어. 정답 ③.

반의어 (5지선다 — C5 위반이나 풀이 진행): 밑줄 'unintentionally' — 'unintentionally consume more calories'. unintentionally = 의도치 않게. 반의어 = deliberately(의도적으로). ①accidentally, ②unknowingly, ③inadvertently는 유의어. ④deliberately — 반의어. 정답 ④.

다의어: (A) 'adaptive problems that confronted modern humans as they spread...' — confronted = (문제가) ~에 닥치다/직면케 하다. (B) 'we are now confronted by huge portions' — confronted = ~에 직면하다(수동). (A)문제가 닥치다-(B)직면하다 = ①.
영영풀이: 'copying written or spoken words exactly as they were originally said or written' = 원문 그대로 베끼는 행위 = verbatim(그대로). ③verbatim — 정답. ①partially(부분적으로), ②randomly(무작위로), ④briefly(간략히)는 불일치. 정답 ③.
어형변환: 'Most humans are __________ (gene) very similar' — gene(명사) → genetically(부사, -ically). similar(형용사) 앞 부사 자리. fullPassage: 'genetically very similar'. 정답: genetically.
어형변환: 'The logic of market __________ (efficient) generally rotates' — efficient(형용사) → efficiencies(명사 복수형). fullPassage: 'the logic of market efficiencies'. 정답: efficiencies.
빈칸 문맥 완성: 'Someone usually mentions that they have a ____.' — fullPassage: 'they have a list'. 쇼핑 비유 맥락에서 학생들이 연구할 때 필요한 것 = list(목록). ③list — 원문 일치. ①live, ②need, ④time은 불일치. 정답 ③.

빈칸 문맥 완성 (5지선다 — C5 위반이나 풀이 진행): 'accumulate pools of adaptive information that greatly exceed the ____ of individuals' — fullPassage: 'inventive capacities'. ④inventive capacities — 원문 일치. ①conventional, ②racialization, ③calculations는 불일치. 정답 ④.
